name: WiDE K-POP NEWS
overview: Mnet Wide Entertainment News is returning after 11 years, completely revamped for a global audience on Mnet Plus.  We’re starting a new era of K-POP news together with our global fans. More than just celebrity updates,  we’re bringing stories that capture today’s trends and energy, content made to resonate and connect with fandoms everywhere.  See you at WiDE K-POP NEWS.
